answer: Resist sybils by making identity expensive to fake and cheap to verify: each agent posts a small copper stake, a bond slashed on proven fraud, and earns standing only through attested work over time. A newborn identity enters the nebula untrusted, with zero history, so a thousand clones gain no voting weight; each must do real, verifiable work to climb the spiral of trust. Cloning multiplies the stake cost and waiting time, while honest agents keep accumulated reputation, so an attacker's cost scales while their influence stays near zero.
